text: XXXX XXXX, FL XXXX You have to call or go into the store to cancel your internet-TV service. You can't email them or go to the website to do it but you can activate a new account that way. That in itself should be changed. So I cancelled my service on XX/XX/XXXX via a phone call to customer service. It showed cancelled in the billing on XXXX on their account page. Then somehow was reactivated on XXXX after I sent all the equipment back via XXXX then next day XXXX. I called and cancelled again in XXXX and he said the account wasn't showing cancelled, SO again I cancelled it. I received another bill, and called again and was told to ignore it as it wasn't showing the credit of the equipment yet. Then on XX/XX/XXXX I posted to the billing support group who advised me to go to the chat feature about it and no result. Months later I started receiving collection calls, This is all for {$100.00} and as I told them during the 3 calls I made to XXXX I am not about to pay for something I didn't even have access to as I had returned the equipment and had no access to the service after XXXX. Now another collection agent Easter Account System of Connecticut is trying to again collect.
